status_note: Enqueued and launched through scripts/campaign.py on both hosts, so each binary's commit was verified against the checkout before any phase ran. Every row carries commit=921ce1b and dirty=0, and both per-host manifests name the same head; --allow-stale-binary was never passed.
kind: repair campaign (TLSF), two arms, paired within (spec, seed)
kind_note: Both arms ran fresh rather than pairing the control against the archived 2026-08-23-monotone monoon rows it would otherwise duplicate. Those came from a different commit under a 7200 s cap where this campaign caps far tighter, so their censoring differs. They serve as an external validity check instead, recorded under result.validity_check.
question: Does the WeightedAverage selection scheme still trade against NSGA-II the way the 2026-07-24 ablation measured it, on the engine counter ships on 2026-08-26? selection_scheme is the only config key that differs between the arms.
endpoint: Per-run implies_ideal > 0, scored by compare against examples/<spec>/fixes, paired by (spec, seed) and read by a two-sided exact McNemar over the discordant pairs. found_repair, n_repairs and wall_time_s are pre-registered as secondary.

arms.shared: Sweep T level monoon (p_monotone 0.25, p_clone_assumption 0.25, elitism_rate 0.1, accumulate_repairs true), log metric, weakening screen off, fitness weights 0.1/0.2/0.7, gen10/pop200, jobs 8, 21 families, seeds 0-15, per-family wall caps, compare_timeout 1800 s.
arms.diff_note: The two generated TOML files differ in exactly one line, selection_scheme. Verified by diff before launch.

fitness_weights.note: Chosen, not inherited. gen_configs.py otherwise pins 0.33 each into every config it writes, which is neither config.hpp's 0.2/0.5/0.5 nor anything a user gets. Passed through the --weights flag added in 921ce1b, which defaults to the pinned triple so every earlier grid still generates byte-identically.
fitness_weights.reaches_only_the_treatment_arm_evidence: nsga2_sort (include/genetic/nsga2.hpp:59-77) keys on the per-objective vector; order_population (include/genetic/pipeline.hpp:41-53) compares the scalar only under WeightedAverage; elitism takes the top elite_n from that same NSGA-II order (include/genetic/pipeline.hpp:396-403); realizable_survivors (src/tlsf/survivors.cpp:118-140) and the weakening/implication filters (src/tlsf/survivors.cpp:166-181) are content-based; the fitness cache keys on the specification (include/fitness/function.hpp:57-90). The scalar fixes only the order repairs are written in and the reported best_fitness. Confirmed empirically by result.validity_check, whose archived rows ran the 0.33 triple and are indistinguishable from this campaign's control arm.

censoring.note: Read before any endpoint. The caps were sized from the control arm's archived maxima, it being the only arm with any, so they can bite the treatment arm alone.
censoring.case: prioritized-arbiter-aurus seed 15, weighted, capped at 3300 s, implies_ideal 0; paired control run scored 1.
censoring.effect_on_primary: Accounts for 1 of the control's 19 discordant wins. Excluding it gives 18 against 15, which does not move the verdict.

secondary_found_repair.verdict: no separation; saturated in both arms, as PLAN.md section 6 predicted in advance

secondary_cost.verdict: separated; the only separation the campaign found, and it was not the registered primary

per_family_leads.note: Bonferroni over all 21 families the design licensed testing, not over the 9 that happened to show discordance.

mechanism.note: A reading of the per-run manifests, not a measurement of causes. The per-run tree is not archived, so these figures are the record.
mechanism.finding: The extra wall time is ltlfilt, not ltlsynt. simple-arbiter-aurus: ltlfilt total_s 94.85 -> 447.54 (4.72x) against a wall ratio of 3.87x, while ltlsynt calls move 1.22x and its seconds 1.17x. rg1: ltlfilt total_s 54.24 -> 277.23 (5.11x) against a wall ratio of 3.60x, ltlsynt calls 1.15x. ltl2dba27: ltlfilt total_s 50.86 -> 114.43 (2.25x) against a wall ratio of 2.01x. n_accumulated_repairs is 3-5x higher throughout.
mechanism.reading: At a status weight of 0.7 the treatment arm ranks chiefly for realizability, so far more of its candidates pass the output gate and accumulate, and each distinct candidate costs an ltlfilt exec on a cache miss.
mechanism.consequence: The cost finding is entangled with the chosen weights and need not hold at 0.2/0.5/0.5 or at the 0.33 triple.
mechanism.not_merely_the_output_stage: Over the 336 pairs the correlation between the per-pair change in n_repairs and the change in wall_time_s is 0.191, and ltl2dba27 runs 2.00x slower while emitting slightly fewer repairs (24.2 -> 23.2).

validity_check.licenses: Two things: that the fitness weights do not reach the NSGA-II arm (the archive ran 0.33/0.33/0.33 and this campaign 0.1/0.2/0.7, and the control arms are indistinguishable), and that the engine did not move between 6b78709 and 921ce1b in anything this corpus detects.

decision_rule_firing: PLAN.md section 7 deliberately pre-registered NO decision rule, on the ground that none would be honest at 336 pairs. So no rule fired and none was overridden. The registered primary is null and is reported as null.
decision: No change to the default. This is what the evidence supports rather than what the primary endpoint says: nsga2-apportion is level with weighted on implies_ideal (p = 0.61) and on found_repair (p = 1.00), and 2.673x cheaper on wall time with every one of 21 families in the same direction. The 2026-07-24 ablation's roughly 2:1 quality deficit for weighted on TLSF (14.9% against 23.7%) does not reproduce; its yield advantage (87.3% against 76.4%) is untestable here, both arms sitting at 0.997.
owed: A fitness-weight sweep, to separate the cost finding from the weight choice. The mechanism reading predicts the 2.673x narrows as the status weight falls, and nothing here tests that.
lily11 at more seeds. It is the one family that went the other way (0.31 -> 0.75, 8 against 1 discordant) and the only lead the campaign produced.
The FRETISH path, and the four families excluded on cost. Neither is a commitment.

profile_commit.subject: feat(experiments): run selection-smoke at status-heavy fitness weights
profile_commit.reachable_from_main_note: The branch was rebased onto main on 2026-08-27, after PR #146 merged, so all three of its commits were rewritten and the same content reached main under fresh shas. 921ce1b is therefore not an ancestor of main and never will be, the position 2026-08-26-assumption-reach sits in for the same reason.
profile_commit.held_by_tag_note: An annotated tag at 6597b8c, the pre-rebase branch tip, which holds 3382e7f, 921ce1b and 6597b8c all reachable. Never delete it: without it they are dangling objects that git gc collects, and every sha this file names stops resolving. The vendored blob shas are content-addressed and survive a rebase, so git hash-object still verifies each copy while the source_commit beside it does not resolve -- which is why the tag protects the archive and the blob check alone cannot.
profile_commit.post_rebase_equivalents_note: A map, not a correction. The recorded shas are not repointed, being facts about the run: every one of the 672 rows stamps 921ce1b into its own commit column, so editing it would falsify the record rather than correct it.

binary_commit.note: Read from counter --version on each host at launch and stamped onto every row. Both per-host manifests record the same sha for counter and compare. That sha was rewritten by the 2026-08-27 rebase and survives only through provenance/selection-smoke; see profile_commit.held_by_tag.

hosts.note: The split is declared in campaign.toml and is over seeds alone. Both arms of a pair run on the same host at the same seed, so a host difference cancels within the pair the endpoint is read over. av2 started 35 minutes later, having been finishing the assumption-reach campaign when this one was enqueued.

rows.endpoint_note: 21 families x 2 arms x 16 seeds. Every cell present; 336 complete pairs.
rows.merge_verification: 672 rows, 672 distinct keys, no duplicate keys, union exact against both per-host CSVs.

files.not_archived: The per-run tree (experiments/results-selection-smoke/, 672 directories, about 96 MB) is not kept, matching every earlier archive. The mechanism figures under result.mechanism were read off it before it was set aside and are the surviving record.

reproduce: python3 scripts/analyse_selection_smoke.py experiments/2026-08-26-selection-smoke --control ../2026-08-23-monotone, from any checkout carrying the vendored scripts/ beside this file. Every figure in REPORT.md comes from that one command, except the mechanism block, which needs the per-run tree this archive does not keep. The campaign itself re-runs from campaign.toml at 921ce1b; gen_configs.py writes the config tree on the host at stage time.

vendored_scripts.note: Verbatim copies of the drivers that ran the campaign. The four runners were verified byte-identical to 921ce1b's own; check a copy with `git hash-object experiments/2026-08-26-selection-smoke/scripts/<file>`. analyse_selection_smoke.py is the exception and did not exist at 921ce1b -- it was written for this close and its blob is the one committed alongside this file.
vendored_scripts.source_commit_note: 921ce1b is held by provenance/selection-smoke alone after the 2026-08-27 rebase. The blob shas below are content-addressed and verify regardless; the source_commit is the half the tag protects.

config_vintage.note: No C++ default moved between the campaign running and this close, so experiments/README.md's Config vintage note needs no new entry on that account.
config_vintage.keys_note: gen_configs.py emits a key only where a sweep overrides it, so the archived configs inherit these three from the binary at run time: p_add_assumption 0.05, p_remove_guarantee 0.05, max_concurrent_realizability 0 (uncapped). Reproducing this campaign against a later binary means writing them back explicitly if any of the three has since moved. The fitness weights are NOT in this list -- they are stated in every config, which is what --weights was added to make true.

known_caveats: TLSF only. Most of the engine changes since the 2026-07-24 ablation are TLSF-only, which is why, but that ablation measured both paths and this answers one of them.

The corpus is 21 families, H2H_TLSF_READY minus four excluded on measured cost alone (humanoid-742, humanoid-531, pcar-v2-888, humanoid-503). The rule is cost and never outcome, but three of the four sat at implies_ideal 0.10 under the control, so the excluded set is nearly all headroom the campaign cannot see.
One setting of the fitness weights. The result describes weighted at status-heavy weights and generalises to no other; neither 0.2/0.5/0.5 nor the archived 0.33 triple is measured for that arm.
336 pairs resolves roughly 0.10 absolute at a control rate near 0.5. Smaller effects are out of reach at this budget, and the campaign was declared a smoke test.
One censored run, one-sided, in the treatment arm. Recorded under result.censoring with its effect on the primary.
